conclusions.text: The eight scoped retained records identify USA ADM2 county subjects with Georgia parent; retained Census rows agree on GEOID, state, name, LSAD county tier and active status. This is limited to the eight issue-declared subjects and does not establish full-state or neighboring completeness.
The bounded comparison report was reproduced twice from the exact retained inputs, and both fresh four-product bundles match the retained baseline byte-for-byte. This confirms reproducibility only.

Legal jurisdiction lines, coast/water/island treatment, neighboring granularity and full Georgia inventory completeness remain unresolved; statistical reference geometries and IoU do not adjudicate these questions.

The applicable reuse license for inherited geoBoundaries geometry remains unresolved; preserve the conflicting Public Domain metadata and CC BY 4.0 project notice without asserting a license conclusion.
